description: Report text reuse conflicts between a base locale and its translations, in both directions. One source string translated several ways makes the interface say the same thing in different words in different places. Several source strings translated identically removes a distinction the product makes in one language and not the other. Neither is visible key by key, which is why this is a property of a pair of files. Comparison folds case and trims whitespace by default. Pay 180000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

case_sensitive.description: Treat a capitalisation difference as a distinct string. Defaults to false.

locales.description: The base locale and the translations to check against it. One entry per locale. Exactly one may be marked as the base; when none is, the first supplied is used and that is reported.

base.description: Whether this is the source locale the others are compared against.

locale.description: A language tag such as en, pt-BR or ar.

messages.description: This locale’s messages. A messages object, or JSON text, at most 2097152 bytes. Nested objects are flattened to separated keys, so a file written either way is read the same. Nothing is fetched: the files are supplied, so an arbitrary project can be audited.

name: translation_memory_conflict_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

consistent.description: True only when every source mapped to one translation and every translation to one source.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

locales.description: Per locale: how many messages were compared, and how many sources diverged or merged.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.
